svg.aria-label: The toad sage's tip: start a message with sage mode to switch it on, and with sage mode off to switch it off. In the middle of a sentence, it does nothing.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Start a message with “sage mode” to switch it on,
and with “sage mode off” to switch it off.
In the middle of a sentence, it does nothing.
